## Problem or use case

What are you trying to do, and what makes it hard or impossible today? Describing the
situation is usually more useful than describing the fix — it leaves room for a better one.

## Proposed solution

What you would like the tool to do.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways you have tried to solve this, in this tool or elsewhere, and why they fall short.

## Additional context

Anything that helps: the relevant part of a UPF/CPF specification, how another tool handles
it, a sketch of the UI, an example design.
